ops.title: Approved cc-sync cross-machine recovery implementation
ops.body:
# Approved cc-sync implementation
User approved implementation of the full plan on 2026-09-26. Create yasyf/cc-sync, using synckit, reposync, cc-transcript discovery, and Orca integration. Do not edit the Forge monorepo. Work from freshly fetched upstream in isolated worktrees; preserve all unrelated active work.

## Required behavior
- Explicit pickup, no automatic takeover. Protect Claude sessions in registered reposync repositories only, respecting local-only exclusions. Existing Synckit peers are destinations.
- Preserve complete Git WIP: unpushed commits/ancestry, staging vs unstaged versions, deleted files, modes, symlinks, nonignored untracked source. Exclude ignored dependencies/build output. Colocated jj recovers files and commits into Git, not jj operation history.
- Orca sessions carry workspace metadata and complete layout, with multiple sessions per workspace. Import all bindings dormant, resume selected only. Other sessions resume via CLI. Repeated sibling pickup reuses checkout without reapplying stale code.
- CLI AND native Orca recovery picker/action. Always recover against LOCAL Orca instance, even while client displays remote execution host.
- ~40 concurrent sessions. Human input/focus within15m:2m capture; autonomous agent activity within15m:5m; activity within1h:15m; older:1h. Human activity wins priority. Two capture workers maximum, one per repo. Metadata/incremental scanning, no recursive node_modules watches.
- Batch missing objects across due sessions per peer with10s coalescing, zstd fast single encoder,32MiB uncompressed batch cap,1MiB transport chunks, bounded decoder size/memory. Reuse unchanged chunks.
- Both endpoints must report known connected unrestricted network. Pause bulk on cellular/expensive/constrained/unknown/disconnected. Local capture continues. Network.framework macOS+manual metered setting. Recheck/cancel at chunks, auto resume. Tiny policy control messages allowed; never bypass cost policy via busy gate. Unmarked cellular backhaul and in-flight chunk limits must be honest.
- Latest+hourly24h+daily7d checkpoints. Expire inactive/deleted sessions7d after source activity; relay doesn't renew. Keep small revision/tombstone metadata to prevent stale resurrection.
- Checkpoints only ready/ACK after ALL session/code/Orca referenced artifacts and commit prerequisites are durable on peer. Surviving peer can relay without source. No false recovery assurance.

## Implementation boundaries
1. reposync exported worktree Discover/Capture/Verify/Restore beside registry.Load. Common-dir aware linked worktree discovery. Portable file manifests/CAS+incremental bundles, source read-only (GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; private scratch refs/index/objects; no source stash/add/write-tree/jj snapshot). Verify/pin receiver prerequisite history. Restore fresh recovery branch/worktree, never overwrite destination. Defer unfinished Git operations/conflicted jj with prior checkpoint retained. Avoid full monorepo history export each tick.
2. synckit generic artifact refs+bounded dependency enumeration/chunk APIs on existing owned authenticated RPC/SSH transport. Reuse daemonkit durable streaming writes.8MiB JSON envelope/16MiB RPC body limit remain; catalog metadata separate. CAS+compression+network policy+delivery status. Existing Notify only exports newer when no Pending: add atomic expected-ChangeID supersede with newer full snapshot, keep Acked, atomically swap pins, serialize active delivery; old ACK cannot clear new Pending; receiver revision fence. Supersede during offline retention too so expired pending does not pin forever.
3. cc-sync Go resident SyncConsumer via helperruntime. synckit remote requires resident. Consumer owns scheduler; manifest debounce only, global reconcile15min unsuitable. Watch a narrow stable stamp root, not all repos (watchbackend rewalks30sec). Inventory native sessions, respect cc-pool canonical ~/.claude versus per-profile projections. Archive raw JSONL complete records and whole <sid>/ tree (subagents/tool-results/workflows), associated tasks/plans/file-history/uploads/images/scratchpad. Exclude machine auth/locks. Keep replicas outside native projects until pickup. Version-tested restore adapter relocates typed machine paths, leaves historical conversation text, supplies recovery context; keep competing continuations separate. CLI install/list/inspect/status/sync/pickup with JSON, source/checkpoint selectors. Native resume same session id, no automatic work prompt, refuse live-local collisions.
4. Orca repo is public stablyai/orca, no ~/Code/orca checkout was found. Add capability-negotiated recovery export/import (do not edit store externally), descriptor includes repo/workspace identity/metadata, complete tab groups/panes/ratios/editor paths/browser URLs, authoritative providerSession bindings incl dormant and launch settings. TUI native resume is terminal.ensureAgentSession, NOT agentSession.ensure (structured chat); preserve structured leaf cursor when relevant.
   Ownership mixed: host owns repo/workspace/PTYS/bindings, client owns additional full view/focus/input. Add authenticated coalesced client->host recovery-presentation publication, keyed workspace instance+client. Persist latest acknowledged view, host combines with authoritative bindings, exports freshness. Recovery prefers receiving client's saved view else most recently human-used view.
   Import accepts already-restored checkout, generates local IDs, path maps, source provenance. Explicit local routing strips ORCA_ENVIRONMENT/PAIRING_CODE and checks status target local and local executionHostId. Import bindings dormant then resume selected. Never run source shell commands/hooks/default commands. CLI and native Orca picker call same cc-sync recovery service and show source/workspace/session/age/completeness/pause reason. No implicit remote execution.
5. Native compatibility fixtures + integration + releases. Claude2.1.280 installed during planning; --system-prompt-snapshot on can ignore new appended system prompt. Test relocation after compaction with subagents, spilled result, task, plan, rewind, scratchpad, attachment, partial JSONL tail, punctuation/Unicode cwd. Native project path encoding differs across cc-transcript and cc-orchestrate; avoid blindly copying either. cc-orchestrate adoptops moves only JSONL, NOT sidecars. spawnllm uses no-session-persistence, wrong resume layer. Existing duplicate native session copies cause lookup ambiguity.

## Known source pointers
synckit syncservice/service.go, daemon/delivery.go, daemon/serve.go, internal/synctransport, watch/engine.go, daemonkit/durable/write.go. Existing purego0.10.1 supports Network.framework via objc.NewBlock. klauspost/compress zstd appropriate dependency. reposync registry/registry.go public read API; internal/vcs currently rejects .git pointer file and sync only trunk, so need real new snapshot API.
Orca src/shared/agent-status-types.ts, src/preload/api/workspace-session-api.ts, src/renderer/src/web/preload-api/web-workspace-session-api.ts, src/shared/remote-workspace-session-projection.ts, src/main/runtime/orca-runtime-hydrate-headless-mobile-session-tabs-from-workspace-session.ts. Headless only partial presentation; runtime:<id> client partition doesn't imply host sync.

## Schedule
Launch independent native fixtures, reposync snapshot, synckit transfer, Orca API/UI lanes together. Coordinate explicit APIs early so cc-sync can build against agreed contracts in isolation while dependencies are verified. Parent coordinator owns synthesis, implementation routes according repo Models table. Full review/fix and integration before claiming completion; no stubs/unwired endpoints counted as done.

## Acceptance
Go CI go vet ./..., go test -race ./..., go build ./...; Orca pnpm tc and focused tests, hidden rendered QA ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH=1. slop-cop docs. End-to-end recover on second machine/source unavailable (or isolated simulated hosts, clearly distinguish observed real-machine acceptance).
Prove partial staging binary/text, deletes/modes/symlinks/new source/unpublished commits, ignored node_modules absent, unchanged source, >8MiB transcripts, missing/corrupt/interrupted chunks no ACK, replay/idempotence, peer relay, network policy both endpoints and transitions, bounded offline supersede with stale ACKs,7d expiration without resurrection,40sessions dedup/priorities/concurrency/zero unchanged payload, multi-session Orca local recovery and sibling never rollback code.
No user approval question for already approved scope. Don't stop at skeleton/submitted-only if required behavior remains. Publish reviewable PRs in repos as their instructions require, but do not auto-merge third-party Orca or roll out unverified binaries over live sessions. Report evidence and exact remaining external gates honestly.
